Definition
[Tangential differential operators]1. ch16:16.2–16.4\group chapter-16 Let $\mathcal U\subset \mathbb R^{n+1}$ be open and let $\Phi \in C^2(\mathcal U)$ have nonvanishing gradient. On egin{equation} \mathcal S=\{ x\in \mathcal U:\Phi (x)=0\} , ag {16.2} \end{equation} take the unit normal $ u =D\Phi /|D\Phi |$. A graph is represented by egin{equation} \Phi (x',x_{n+1})=x_{n+1}-u(x'), \qquad x'\in \Omega . ag {16.3} \end{equation} For $g\in C^1(\mathcal U)$, define egin{equation} \delta g=Dg-( u \cdot Dg) u . ag {16.4} \end{equation}

This is the tangential projection of $Dg$, depends only on $g|_{\mathcal S}$, and satisfies egin{equation} u \cdot \delta g=0, ag {16.5} \end{equation} egin{equation} |\delta g|^2=|Dg|^2-| u \cdot Dg|^2, ag {16.6} \end{equation} egin{equation} |\delta g|\le |Dg|, ag {16.7} \end{equation} egin{equation} | u _{n+1}|\, |Dg|\le |\delta g| \quad ext{if }D_{n+1}g=0. ag {16.8} \end{equation} The mean curvature with respect to $ u $ is egin{equation} H=- rac1n\delta _i u _i. ag {16.9} \end{equation}
